messages:
sana: Heads-up: AtlasPay procurement added exportable tamper-evident bundles + tenant legal-hold API. They asked for 3/7/10yr retention lanes and pilot acceptance criteria before signing.

liam: Quick questions: BYOK required for pilot? And do they need a signed manifest or a verifiable hash-chain across chunks?

may: Procurement said BYOK is negotiable for pilot. They need verifiable manifests they can check. Proposal: Phase 1 (pilot) = platform-signed manifest + legal-hold toggle + export verification docs. Phase 2 = BYOK/KMS handshake, escrow, and SOC2 evidence packaging.

sana: Ops note: our nightly exporter currently strips some request provenance (node_id/request_id). We need to persist that for chain-of-custody. Expect a small ETL change.

liam: Rough eng guess: 1 backend engineer x 2 sprints to (1) persist provenance fields, (2) add manifest signing step, (3) wire legal-hold bypass for GC. Export runner changes ~0.5 sprint for chunking/index.

may: Pilot acceptance checklist (draft): 1) manifest includes tenant_id, export_time, chunk_index, chunk_digest, cumulative_digest, signer_id, signature; 2) customer can run verification instructions in docs; 3) legal-hold API prevents GC and emits audit events visible in Console; 4) exports finish within agreed SLA for tenants <2TB; 5) runbook with throttling/retry exists.

liam: Example minimal manifest we can sign (human-readable):
```
tenant: atlaspay
export_id: exp-2026-08-12T14:00:00Z
chunks: 8
items: 412345
cumulative_digest: sha256:abcd...
signer: redwood-exports@redwood.ai
signature: base64(...)
```

compliance-bot: Reminder: open compliance-ticket with customer, retention lanes, manifest schema link, and BYOK preference.

sana: Action items: @liam post low-level PR estimate + data-model diff by EOD; @may draft SOC2 mapping and contract language by Tue; I'll prep pilot runbook + comms. If estimates <3 dev-sprints we'll slot into Q3 backlog. :thumbsup:
